items.quote: After a major storm, we found a leak over our garage in a section that had supposedly been repaired by another roofer before. We called Brave Roofers, and Gerald responded quickly, came out within a few days to inspect the roof.

Gerald and his crew are real roofing pros. They were thorough, skilled, and very honest from the first roof inspection. After checking my roof problems, they were glad to let me take time to compare other roofing estimates.

After storm damage, I got a few roofing estimates and chose the crew that felt the most honest and detailed. Jeff was very thorough with the quote and explained the roofing work in simple terms, from shingles to cleanup.
